articles.title: Aroldis Chapman records 400th save, Red Sox finish 4-game sweep of Orioles
articles.description: Aroldis Chapman reached a major career milestone Sunday as the Red Sox finished up a four-game sweep of the Orioles.

articles.title: Former Red Sox manager Joe Morgan dies at age 95
articles.description: Former Red Sox manager Joe Morgan, who led one of the most memorable second-half turnarounds in franchise history, died Saturday at age 95.

articles.title: Red Sox place outfielder on injured list with strained right quad
articles.description: After taking things day-to-day throughout the past week, the Red Sox opted to place their Gold Glove outfielder on the injured list Sunday with a strained quad.

articles.title: Farm Report: Top Red Sox picks off to fast start at High-A Greenville
articles.description: Just a few months removed from leading UNC baseball to the College World Series final, top Red Sox draft picks Jake Schaffner and Owen Hull have gotten off to fantastic starts to their pro careers.

articles.title: Red Sox motivated by Oriole’s antics: ‘We wanted to kind of bury them’
articles.description: A bizarre benches-clearing incident earlier in the series provided the Red Sox with extra motivation Saturday, with one player admitting it made them want to “bury” the Orioles.

articles.title: Sonny Gray shuts down Orioles, Red Sox clinch series with 3rd straight win
articles.description: Sonny Gray was brilliant and the Red Sox bats came to life late as the club picked up its third straight win to clinch the weekend series against the Orioles.

articles.title: Ranger Suarez throws seven scoreless innings as Red Sox shut out Orioles
articles.description: Ranger Suarez outdueled Shane Baz and Mickey Gasper’s first-inning home run made the difference as the Red Sox shut out the Orioles for their second straight win.

articles.title: Adley Rutschman homers twice in return to Baltimore as Red Sox beat Orioles
articles.description: Adley Rutschman homered twice in his first game back in Baltimore, helping power the Red Sox to a series-opening win over the Orioles.

articles.title: Red Sox manager says outfielder is battling quad tightness
articles.description: One of the Red Sox most durable players was subbed out early for the second consecutive game on Wednesday. Chad Tracy explained why postgame.

articles.title: Red Sox doomed by sloppy play, suffer sixth loss in last eight games
articles.description: The Red Sox repeatedly shot themselves in the foot Wednesday, suffering their sixth loss in the last eight games.

articles.title: Mariners hitter shares his side of viral moment with Red Sox’s Payton Tolle
articles.description: “I’m gonna give you a hug, brother.” What Dominic Canzone saw as Red Sox pitcher Payton Tolle barreled down the first base line on Monday.

articles.title: Red Sox manager provides latest update on injured catcher
articles.description: Chad Tracy provided another update on Adley Rutschman, who is not in the Red Sox lineup for the third straight game.

articles.title: Red Sox option rookie starter after rough outing Tuesday night
articles.description: The Red Sox shook up their bullpen on Wednesday, optioning a rookie starter following his rough start against the Mariners earlier this week.

articles.title: Red Sox rookie roughed up, late rally falls short in loss to Mariners
articles.description: Rookie call-up Jedixson Paez took a beating in his Red Sox debut, and Boston couldn’t pull off another comeback in a 9-6 loss to Seattle.

articles.title: Finally healthy, Red Sox infielder ready to utilize ‘elite’ skill in niche role
articles.description: Back after more than two months on the IL, Isiah Kiner-Falefa believes his “elite” defense can help the Red Sox down the stretch.

articles.title: Red Sox’s Adley Rutschman sits again vs. Mariners, ‘day to day’ with elbow issue
articles.description: Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman is dealing with elbow irritation that could linger for the rest of the season, according to interim manager Chad Tracy.
